aha: The crab rushes along the open corridor: drop the pearl into it (crushing the crab if timed), shove it along behind you as a shield, and leave through the hole when the crab is far away.
deadlocks: Stepping out to the floor hole when the crab is close: it rushes along the clear row and gets you.
Leaving the dig under the pearl downwards: the pearl falls on the diver.
